ALHUB.title: Arcano Lab Hub

connect.title: Your Lab key, in one click.
connect.step1: Sign in with Patreon. We only read your name and your membership.
connect.step2: Get your personal install links for every module your tier unlocks.
connect.step3: Updates keep flowing while you're a patron. Cancel and you keep what you have.
connect.waiting: Waiting for Patreon in the new tab…
connect.fine: Arcano Lab never sees your Patreon password. You can disconnect at any time.

ALHUB.howto: {title} — install link copied. Open Setup → Add-on Modules → Install Module, paste it in Manifest URL and click Install. Updates will show up there too.

update.title: Update {title}
update.body: Foundry updates modules from the Setup screen: Setup → Add-on Modules → Update All (or the update button next to {title}). Your link stays valid while you're a patron.

news.title: Lab notes
news.lead: What changed in every experiment, newest first.

account.title: Account
account.name: Patreon
account.fine: Your Lab key is personal: it is part of your install links. Don't share it — if it leaks, disconnect and connect again to get a new one.

toast.updates: Arcano Lab: {n} module update(s) available. Open the Hub to see them.
toast.expired: Your Patreon membership couldn't be confirmed. Updates are paused until you connect again.
toast.loginFailed: Patreon sign-in didn't finish. Try again.
toast.offline: Can't reach the Arcano Lab server right now — showing the last saved list.

settings.openHint: Your Arcano Lab modules, install links and updates.

server.name: Hub server
server.hint: Address of the Arcano Lab server. Only change this if Arcano Lab asks you to.

notify.name: Update notices
notify.hint: Tell the GM when an Arcano Lab module has a new version.

lang.name: Hub language
lang.hint: Language of the Hub window, notices and settings. "Follow Foundry" uses the same language as Foundry. Reloads the page.
